svg.text: Challenge 2 — the experiment log
Research → X1 (negative) → X2 (positive). 15 October 2026. Every number below is measured, not estimated.
PHASE 0 · RESEARCH
Three public entries reviewed
RFdiffusion 0/48 docked · BoltzGen 5 runs, best ipTM 0.46 · notes 01–07 written
PLAN · PRE-REGISTERED
X1 spec, stop rules, hotspot rule
pass bar: ipSAE ≥ 0.6 ∧ pDockQ2 ≥ 0.23 ∧ ≥100 contacts · span ≤15 Å · full trimer
TOOLING
Tamarind agent key · local stack
no login needed · 10 jobs/month · validate free · Mac MPS fork imports (checkpoint blocked)
X1 · SUBMITTED
3 × BoltzGen, 150 designs
S1 {A65,A67,C75} · S2 {A103,B103,B112} · S3 none · ~60 min each · 3 jobs
X1 · VERDICT — NEGATIVE
0 / 150 designs dock
best design→target ipTM 0.36 · ipSAE ≈ 0 · touches the surface, no confident interface
X2 · COMPLETE — PLACEMENT WORKS
58 / 72 designs in the groove
spanning two protomers · 72/72 touch the 60s loop · 27 clashy · billed 6 jobs
DECISIVE CO-FOLD · PASSED
1 of 5 samples passes the bar
ipSAE 0.80 · pDockQ2 0.24 vs X1's 0.005 · seed variance is the caveat
Key facts carried forward:
• the 36 Å hotspot map failed; ≤15 Å worked (C1)
• partial targets let binders fill the missing protomer
Pre-registration in research-phase-0 §5.
S1 built from 3WD5 contacts + mouse conservation
+ exposure; winner spans 12.7 Å across two protomers.
Key path: ~/.config/tamarind/api_key
Claim URL issued → Clerk sign-in (Google / email / SSO)
Settings: 70–95 aa binders · numDesigns 50 · refold ON
· binding-site post-filter OFF (adherence measured locally)
· full trimer A+B+C, never a partial target
Evidence: S1 best 162/639 atoms within 4 Å of the trimer
(closest pair 1.4 Å) — yet interface ipSAE ≈ 0.005.
The no-hotspot diagnostic S3 fails too → site is not the limiter.
Quota lesson: rfdiffusion3 bills ≈1 job per 8 designs.
boltzgen bills 1 job per run (X1: 3 jobs).
Quota resets 1 November — after the C2 deadline.
Placement measured locally; Boltz-2 (independent) folded 5 samples:
1 passed (ipSAE 0.80), 1 near (0.53), 1 partial, 2 lost it.
Next: repeat folds (PC route) · switch layer · mouse check.
Rules that held through every step:
full trimer only · hotspot span ≤15 Å · pass bar fixed before the spend · one writer per file · watchers download results on settle · every claim dated and sourced
